verdict.rationale: Pulley documents an 83(b) Election status tracker and broadly claims its 'equity compliance software' handles 'tax filings' and ASC 718 reporting as a company grows, but there is no specific mention of Rule 701 disclosure threshold tracking or Form 3921 filing generation. Missing for 10: explicit Rule 701 threshold monitoring/alerts, Form 3921 generation/filing workflow, and evidence these are auto-generated directly from cap table data rather than manual processes.
